attackPaths.title: Server-Side Request Forgery in URL preview pivoting into SQL Injection in account lookup
attackPaths.summary: An attacker sends requests to the public interface (api.example.test), exploits SSRF, pivots into internal services, and executes SQL Injection in account lookup to compromise backend databases.

nodes.label: Server-Side Request Forgery in URL preview

prerequisites: Lack of internal network egress filtering
attackPaths.impactAssessment: High-severity breach involving internal pivot and sensitive data compromise.
recommendedFixSequence: 1. Immediately enforce strict egress firewalling & input validation on api.example.test
2. Sanitize database queries and rotate credentials on api.example.test

remediations.title: Enforce Cryptographic Token Verification & Auth Middleware on api.example.test
remediations.engineeringAction: Verify asymmetric JWT signatures (RS256) and reject unsigned / "none" algorithm tokens at the API gateway layer.
architecturalSafeguards: Mandatory expiration and audience claim checks
remediations.validationRequirements: Verify via targeted security re-test and regression scan that 2 finding(s) no longer replicate.

remediations.title: Enforce Parameterized SQL Queries & Prepared Statements on api.example.test
remediations.engineeringAction: Refactor dynamic SQL queries on /api/accounts to use parameterized queries/ORM with strict query parameter typing.
architecturalSafeguards: Database user principle of least privilege
remediations.validationRequirements: Verify via targeted security re-test and regression scan that 1 finding(s) no longer replicate.

remediations.title: Harden Outbound HTTP Requests & Network Egress on api.example.test
remediations.engineeringAction: Implement strict destination allowlisting, block RFC1918/link-local IP addresses (169.254.169.254), and disable HTTP redirects on /api/preview.
remediations.validationRequirements: Verify via targeted security re-test and regression scan that 1 finding(s) no longer replicate.

remediations.title: Enforce Cryptographic Token Verification & Auth Middleware on Source Codebase
remediations.engineeringAction: Verify asymmetric JWT signatures (RS256) and reject unsigned / "none" algorithm tokens at the API gateway layer.
architecturalSafeguards: Mandatory expiration and audience claim checks
remediations.validationRequirements: Verify via targeted security re-test and regression scan that 1 finding(s) no longer replicate.

remediations.title: Upgrade Vulnerable Dependencies & Packages on payment-service:latest
remediations.engineeringAction: Update vulnerable packages to patched upstream versions to eliminate known CVEs.
remediations.validationRequirements: Verify via targeted security re-test and regression scan that 1 finding(s) no longer replicate.

remediations.title: Remediate Exposed database administration service
remediations.engineeringAction: Apply secure coding standards and input sanitization to :5432 on db.internal.example.test.
remediations.validationRequirements: Verify via targeted security re-test and regression scan that 3 finding(s) no longer replicate.

remediations.title: Apply Context-Aware Contextual Output Encoding & CSP on web.example.test
remediations.engineeringAction: Sanitize and encode all untrusted user reflections in /search and deploy a restrictive Content-Security-Policy (CSP) header.
remediations.validationRequirements: Verify via targeted security re-test and regression scan that 1 finding(s) no longer replicate.
